annotations.title: Indoor plants in Dubai: the guide

description: The starting point for anything about houseplants and indoor plants in Dubai: choosing by light (low, medium, bright indirect, direct sun), by room and for pets; what air conditioning, tinted glass and dry air change; where to buy and what it costs; how care changes through the year; common problems; and our indoor styles, with every plant linked. Ask for one section (light, rooms, pets, dubai, year, buying, problems, styles, faq) or all of it, and add a month for what to buy and do that month. Then shortlist with search_plants (light, petSafe, room, size) and read one plant with get_plant.

month.description: Also return what to buy and do indoors in this month: 1–12 or a name such as "october". Leave it out for the guide alone.

section.description: Which part of the guide: light (by light level), rooms, pets (pet-safe plants), dubai (air conditioning, glass, dry air), year (care through the year), buying (where to buy), problems, styles (the indoor styles) or faq. all (default) returns everything.
